text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- King Hussein says in remarks on shooting by soldier who killed seven Israeli schoolgirls: "I hope that the Baqura incident will be an element of awakening for all; we are committed to peace and proud of our army and its tradition."
- King receives letter from Iraqi President Saddam delivered by Iraqi information minister to Prime Minister Kabariti; prime minister stresses Jordan's support of Iraqi people.
- Kabariti says king's visit to Washington gains enormous importance in view of crisis in Middle East peace process.
- King says shooting of Israeli schoolgirls not politically motivated but "vile crime".
- Kabariti says "crime is not justified and the perpetrator will be put on trial according to the law".
- Crown Prince says "this is a black day in the history of the country"; shooting was individual criminal act.
